scope: Independent real-handler Group7 finale, individual lantern/source returns,18 current story/memory routes, exact closing/copy receipts, start/middle acknowledgment and hard-reload distinctions, fixed outcome presentation and replay. Starts from authentic captured Group6 payloads. Transport envelope metadata and explicitly labeled impossible-state codec probes are synthetic; no native storage injection, microphone use or provider requests. Separate native review is required.
